commit_title: Display mapping equation in style settings
commit_message: Add a small informational panel to StyleElementSettings that renders the mapping equation used for value interpolation (Y = min + (max-min) × X). When mappingType is 'curve' the computed exponent (log-clamped to avoid domain errors) is shown as a superscript. The panel uses compact monospace styling and notes that X is normalized between 0 and 1 to help users understand how data values map to style outputs.
